subject: Educação Física
description_pt: Experimentar, fruir e recriar danças urbanas, identificando seus elementos constitutivos (ritmo, espaço, gestos).

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos constitutivos de danças urbanas, incluindo ritmo, espaço e gesto
components.description_en: Identify constitutive elements of urban dances, including rhythm, space, and gesture
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Explorar e apreciar formas de dança urbana em contextos escolares
components.description_en: Explore and appreciate urban dance forms in school contexts

components.description_pt: Reinventar movimentos de dança urbana manipulando criativamente ritmo, espaço ou gesto
components.description_en: Reinvent urban dance movements by creatively manipulating rhythm, space, or gesture

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
